markers.reading: Play opens at twilight at the sheltered camp, immediately after the already-completed short rest.

evidence.quote: the sky directly above you is clear as day turns to twilight and the stars begin to come out
you've just come out of the short rest
it's now full twilight, with the stars just coming out.

time.basis: DM opening and confirmation; the preceding rest is boundary context, not a newly played hour.

markers.reading: Seeker exposes the shallow grave in about a minute.

evidence.quote: the grave is fairly shallow, so it only takes you up, you know, a minute or so to just sort of excavate the top layer and expose the, um, the grave

markers.reading: Delwath meditates for ten minutes to activate magical sight; the later answers establish that it is active.

evidence.quote: Delwath: While this is—while this is happening, I'm gonna bring it. I'm gonna meditate into my fey sight, sight thing and see if anything's magical.
DM: Okay, so that takes 10 minutes to activate. Right? Yes. Okay, um—
So the sphere is magical

DM: Oh, yes. By now it's, yeah, it's probably been, you know, an hour in between the climbing up and all that 10-minute meditations and applying oils and things. Um, yes, you can see the stars better.

duration.basis: DM activation duration, followed by actual magical-sight results

markers.reading: About an hour has elapsed during the climb and platform investigations, including meditation and applying oil; the stars are now clearer.

evidence.quote: DM: Oh, yes. By now it's, yeah, it's probably been, you know, an hour in between the climbing up and all that 10-minute meditations and applying oils and things. Um, yes, you can see the stars better.

duration.basis: DM retrospective aggregate estimate; includes t03 rather than adding another ten minutes

time.basis: Stars visible after approximately an hour from twilight; later contrast explicitly calls the tower night.

markers.reading: Ascending the tower stairs opens an apparent sunlit mountain frame; later revelation establishes an illusory overlay, not overnight passage.

evidence.quote: you come out onto a rocky, barren mountainside.
The sun is shining

Seeker: Is it daytime here, even though it was night where we were just where—
DM: It's daytime.
the mountain vanishes.

time.basis: Apparent daylight stated in the illusion; does not establish an adventure clock or date advance.

markers.reading: The giant claims the current year is 5031 by his true reckoning; the party cannot initially reconcile that with its present.

evidence.quote: It is the 5000—5030 first year of this world. 5031.
DM: "By the true reckoning of time."
Ah, no, you don't have any ideas

time.basis: Hralgar’s stated local year, in a confused illusory frame; calendar equivalence is not established.

markers.reading: The party gives its own present as 5881 dwarven reckoning and 1748 Drankorian era, which Hralgar rejects as too far in the future.

evidence.quote: Seeker: Oh, in our the year on our timeline of the dwarven reckoning is 5881.
Seeker: Right, it's, it's also 1748 Drankorian era.
that is too far in the future.

time.basis: Seeker explicitly states the party’s Drankorian year; month and day are not spoken.

markers.note: This is a present-year claim, not evidence that the party traveled between calendar years.

markers.reading: The mountain vanishes during the continuous conversation, revealing the ruined top floor and the chained giant; the tower frame resumes.

evidence.quote: DM: And as he as his head lays to rest on the tower, he closes his eyes, and a sigh escapes his lips, and the mountain vanishes.
DM: And you are standing on the top floor of the tower, a giant, same appearance, chained to the floor, missing his eyes, his robes tattered and in shreds. The—his hair and beard raggedy, ragged.
now sounding exactly as the voice you remember speaking to you, Delwath

time.basis: Inferred continuation of the tower’s night; no intervening overnight or true time travel is established.

yamlCheck.dateAnchor: The party states 1748 Drankorian (t07); April 15 is supplied only by YAML. Hralgar’s 5031 is retained in its illusory/confused frame, not converted into a date transition.
yamlCheck.explanation: Continuous twilight/night investigation and conversation account for one evening. The mountain daylight vanishes without a rest or night passing; Hralgar’s reported centuries concern imprisonment before this session. The opening rest was already complete before current play.
